content.text:
I've submitted index 16 (Ca 0.33, Fe 0.51, Mn 0.15) as the best composition, but the campaign didn't find a clearly good photoanode. All three photocurrents are close to zero, so this pick is essentially at the noise floor.

The budget was 3 photocurrent measurements and 5 XRD measurements, across 183 candidates. I spent the 3 photocurrent measurements moving from the Fe-rich corner toward the Ca-rich one:

| Index | Composition (Ca / Fe / Mn) | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 0.14 / 0.70 / 0.16 | −1e-8 A |
| 16 | 0.33 / 0.51 / 0.15 | +1e-8 A |
| 111 | 0.52 / 0.31 / 0.18 | −8e-8 A |

Index 16 is the only positive reading, which is why I submitted it. After the first two readings, the Gaussian-process model's top suggestions were all in the Ca ~0.2–0.42 range with predicted means near 5e-9 A. So that middle, Fe-rich-to-moderate band stayed the most promising unexplored area. I did not measure anything in the Mn-rich half of the library.

I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I can't say which crystal phases are present. The final score will depend on whether the library has a much stronger composition somewhere I didn't sample.
